player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci Indian Poker.
- Paaka 52 kaart; ngay gis kaartu réewam rek.
- Kuur-guur {ante} chip(s) ci kuur, {max_rounds} kuur ci wépp.
- Ñaw léegi: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X mooy ab limu parlé ci suuf <= limu chip yi ngay am.)
- Kaart géej gën a kawe moo waral pot ci showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Waxtaa naan na bracketed action, bugga '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', walla '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Wàllug bet / raise war na nekk ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Amul dara lu ñu woo; mën nga [check] ci sa wàll.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Jëf [bet X] ngir ubbi; amul benn bet bu ñu war a yékkati.
invalid_move.insufficient: Jëf yu doyul ngir jëf boobu.

board.possible_actions: Sa jëf yu mën a am: {legal}

message.showdown_win: Jëfandikukat: {card_win} moo gën a màgg ci {card_lose}.
message.showdown_tie: Nettali: ñoom ñaar {card}. Gànnaay bi ñu séddale  kenn ku nekk jot na {split} .

outcome.draw: Ay xëpp yu yem ci ginnaaw bépp wër-gërëm.
